title: Tanzanian Beef Coconut Curry
community: Swahili coast — the richest everyday beef curry
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Mchuzi wa Nyama ya Nazi — Tanzanian beef and coconut curry. Tender beef in a rich coconut milk and tomato sauce with the full coastal spice array. The coastal version of beef stew — richer, more aromatic, and more deeply satisfying.
longDesc: The coconut milk in this curry does two things: it makes the sauce richer and creamier, and it slightly sweetens the beef stew, producing a depth of flavour that plain tomato-based stew cannot match. It is the coastal version of mchuzi wa nyama.
steps: Cook onions until golden. Add garlic, ginger, spices.
Add tomatoes. Cook 8 minutes until thick.
Return beef. Add water. Simmer covered 55—60 minutes until very tender.
Add coconut milk. Simmer gently 10 minutes.
chefTips: Never add coconut milk before the beef is tender.
Simmer gently after adding coconut milk.
cookingScience: See TZA026 for coconut milk science.
culturalNote: Beef coconut curry is how the Swahili coast transforms the everyday beef stew into something extraordinary — the addition of coconut milk is the coastal signature that makes everything better.
